articles.title: Trump Says a United Ireland Would Be 'Fantastic' — And It's a Big Deal
articles.summary: President Trump visited Ireland and said he'd love to see Ireland and Northern Ireland become one country. That's a touchy topic — past U.S. presidents usually stayed quiet about it. Protests broke out in Dublin.

articles.title: India vs Sri Lanka: Who Wins the Women's T20 Asia Cup Final?
articles.summary: India and Sri Lanka play the Women's T20 Asia Cup final on Sunday in Dubai. India has won the trophy seven times. Sri Lanka won last time and wants to keep it. Both teams are unbeaten so far.

articles.title: A Political Party Just Got £72 Million in Two Days — Here's Why That's a Record
articles.summary: Reform UK received two £36 million donations in two days — more money than all UK parties got last year combined. The donors are cryptocurrency investors. Some people worry about where political money comes from.
